high_level_description: The image depicts a person leaning over the edge of a balcony or rooftop. They have several bangles on their wrist and are resting their head on their hands, which are placed on the white railing of the balcony. The background is slightly blurred, suggesting an urban setting with buildings and greenery visible in the distance. The sky appears to be overcast, contributing to a calm and serene atmosphere.
